scvi_source: FottenSC/Scuffle movelists/mitsurugi.sc6_movelist (MIT) — live-memory movelist bytecode dump, parsed offline with the upstream MovelistParser.py
honesty: Frame data is EXTRACTED from the game's movelist bytecode, not estimated. No move names exist in the source data. Commands are the parser's raw output (may contain '.'/'?' placeholders) — not cleaned engine inputs. limb is 'unknown' (hitbox limb bytes undecoded upstream). knock/soulGain are 0 (no SCVI source basis). recovery seconds are clamped at 0; the raw parser value is in scvi.frame_data. .mot animation MOTION is not in this bank — only the animation id (anim_ref), which resolves when .mot is cracked.
